title: Journal pnl is gross local compute (-786.10) vs venue closed_pnl (-888.30) on trade 6817: which is stored as pnl, should every close take venue closed_pnl
note: Links to COST-BROKER-SOURCED. Trade 6817 (bybit_1 XRPUSDT long, 74160 qty): journal pnl -786.096 (pnl_source local_compute = (1.2476-1.2582)*74160, no fees) vs Bybit closed_pnl -888.3026 (venue figure, includes fees; journal fee_taker_usd estimate 102.64 + 786.10 = 888.74 vs 888.30). Questions: (1) is journal pnl meant to be gross with fees held separately in fee_*_usd, or net; (2) should every close take venue closed_pnl where the venue serves a trustworthy one (demo closed-pnl is deliberately untrusted, BL-20260608-DEMOPNL, so for bybit_1 the gap is by design); (3) which figure do graders and promotion records read. Measure over closed bybit rows: sum(pnl) vs sum(venue closed_pnl) per account before deciding. 2026-11-06 BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261106: RE-DATED to 2026-11-13. Tier 3 question. The journal diag surface exposes no venue closed_pnl column (checked 1000 newest trades), so sum(pnl) vs closed_pnl cannot be measured from it; cost_source=broker now on most closed rows (bybit_1 296 broker/151 estimate of 458 closed in newest 1000). Needs a lane with the closed-pnl store; relates to COST-BROKER-SOURCED.
